comment.narrative: This indicator measures the number of women's rights organisations that have received support from CMI members

In 2025, CMI! supported fourteen WROs and one WHRD in Africa working for the promotion and protection of the rights of WHRDs, women ex-prisoners, and LBTQI people, sex workers, migrant women domestic workers, and girls. Through this support, WROs and the one WHRD strengthened their L&A capacities and their holistic security. Digital, physical, psychosocial security systems and practices were reinforced through the adoption of a wide range of measures like regular security audits and risk assessments, relocation of offices, multi-factor authentication, regular software update, and employee training. These measures have improved WHRD's and WROs' own safety and the physical and emotional security of their staff.

In 2024, CMI! supported a wide variety of WROs across Africa to strengthen their L&A capacities and their holistic security. These organizations worked with many different groups, including but not limited to LBTQI+ persons, women and girls with disabilities, women ex prisoners, sex workers, and young feminists. They advanced feminist demands related to sexual health and reproductive rights, gender-based violence, economic empowerment, LBQTI+ rights, bodily autonomy, and access to justice. Thanks to this support, WROs were able to continue advancing feminist demands in key decision-making spaces at different levels, promoting the rights of women and gender-diverse groups as well as strengthening their organizational security systems through the adoption of new digital, psychosocial, physical, and environmental measures.

This indicator is also unique, as the number of WROs supported by CMI members will be reported only once. If different support is provided to the same WROs, they will be counted once, and details will be provided in the comment box.

Through CMI!, Mama Cash provides Women’s Rights Organisations (WROS) with core funding to build resilient organisations. Core funding is flexible support to WROs to adapt strategically and work sustainably in contexts with high levels of discrimination, political repression and conflict sensitivity.
